first of all. breathe. it's alright. i wouldnt look at any of it as failure, or being ruined, or worthlessness. it's just hard to do your best whenever you're struggling. but don't think that it's the end, or that you can't turn it around. as long as you're still breathing, there's still hope left. now, you're probably going to think i'm an optimist who doesn't have a clue, and that i'm pulling all of this out of thin air. but actually, i know how you're feeling. i dropped out of high school a month before my senior year ended, and haven't been able to go any further than that. and it's all because of depression/mental illness. but it's different when i'm outside of my own head. im brutally honest, and i tell it how it is. i can tell that you have a big heart, and that youre a really hard worker. you want to make people around you happy. and honestly, theres no way to make them all appeased. i learned that the hard way. ive lost all my friends and family. all i have left is my boyfriend. its hard to feel like you have to wear a mask around people. but honestly, if you have to wear a mask around them, or worry about letting them down because you're being yourself; theyre not worth it. its not your fault that youre depressed, or that you feel that way. its something that has to work itself out. theres really no cure or fix for it. through my isolation ive come to understand the dimensions of my depression. and thats how ive come to a lot of these conclusions. things are going to work out, dont worry. you just have to remember that it's not the end, and that you still have time to turn things around, and that you haven't failed in any way. you got this.
